name: Voxel Grid Accelerated Ray-Point Intersection
aliases: GPU voxel grid for ray casting
definition: An accelerated structure for finding the k nearest points within a cylinder of radius δ around a query ray r = (ro, rd) in a point cloud P, designed for parallel GPU execution and dynamic scenes where the point cloud changes frequently.
summary: Voxel Grid Accelerated Ray-Point Intersection is a GPU-optimized method that uses an O(n) voxel grid to efficiently find k nearest points to a ray, outperforming static structures in dynamic scenes.
